messages:
maya.nguyen: quick heads-up — finished the overnight sweep comparing A100 vs H100 for Mistral-7B. ran q8x4 and q4_0 across us-west and eu-west, mixed prefill/decode workloads. putting quick highlights here.

perf-bot: summary CSV attached (see below). generated at 03:10 UTC.

kevin.li: nice — can you paste the p50/p95 for prefill+decode, tokens/sec, and $/1M tokens?

maya.nguyen: sure, here's the compact table i used for the triage:
```
model,gpu,region,prefill_p95_ms,decode_toks_per_sec,$_per_1M_tokens
Mistral-7B,H100,us-west,1200,6500,$18
Mistral-7B,A100,us-west,1900,4200,$25
Mistral-7B,H100,eu-west,1350,6200,$19.5
Mistral-7B,A100,eu-west,2050,4000,$26
```
notes: q8x4 runs were the baseline. q4_0 ran slightly faster on H100 but showed small quality delta.

olivia.chen: did you hit any kernel fallbacks or thermal alarms in eu-west H100 during the run?

perf-bot: infra alert: eu-west-h100-12 transient thermal-throttle at 03:12 UTC (duration ~45s). impacted 2 of 120 jobs, tail latency +~220ms for those jobs.

maya.nguyen: saw that — re-ran the affected shards and results are consistent on median, tail is noisy for that host only. KV-cache hit mattered: when hit ~85% tokens/sec increased ~12% across both GPUs.

kevin.li: q4_0 quality — any regressions on the eval suites?

maya.nguyen: q4_0 produced a small LM score drop vs q8x4: avg logprob delta -0.6, EM drop ~1.1% on our 5k prompt eval. On a handpicked set of 7 sensitivity prompts, 3 showed minor hallucination increase (short factual errors).

olivia.chen: thanks. propose next steps: 1) pin the kernel to fast-attn on A100 for q8x4 runs (avoid fallback), 2) re-run q4_0 with extended context (2x length) to check cache behavior, 3) canary on dedicated us-west-h100 pool for 6 hours. sound good?

santiago.morales: +1 to the plan. i'll reserve 4 nodes on dedicated for tomorrow morning and add batch-size sweep (1,2,4) so we can see scaling.

maya.nguyen: will open a formal bench run and upload full CSV/dashboard. quick note on cost calc: used spot equivalent GPU price * total GPU runtime / tokens_generated, normalized to 1M tokens. that's where the $/1M numbers came from (H100 wins due to higher tokens/sec even at slightly higher per-hour).

kevin.li: can you link the raw CSV and the cost notebook? want to confirm assumptions (spot price, I/O overhead).

maya.nguyen: link: https://drive.redwood.internal/sweeps/3189992222-mistral7b-shadowrun.csv and cost notebook at https://notebooks.redwood.internal/bench/318999-costs.ipynb. assumptions listed in the notebook header.

olivia.chen: good. if q4_0 quality drop persists in the canary, i recommend delaying quant rollout for Mistral-7B until we can tune the quant params or use a hybrid q8x4 for risky routes.

maya.nguyen: agreed. i'll include a small eval harness in the canary that runs the 200-sample regression set after every 1k requests and will post results in #eng-ml.

kevin.li: perfect — thanks for the fast sweep. :thumbsup:

infra-bot: reserved 4x us-west-h100-dedicated nodes for santiago.morales (04:00-10:00 UTC).

maya.nguyen: thanks all — will update here once the canary starts and when the dashboard is live.

kevin.li: ping me if you see >1% EM regress on the 200-sample check, we'll pause rollout automatically.

maya.nguyen: noted, will do.
